name: Rickshaw Rush
summary: An endless city runner: drive a painted rickshaw, jump potholes, duck banners and race from day into night
about: A side-scrolling runner where a green-and-yellow rickshaw races through a city drawn in layers: kites and minarets far away, shopfronts with signboards and awnings, street lamps, cones, fruit carts, goats and festival bunting on the road. Every 500 metres you reach a new district and the sky shifts from morning to sunset to a lamp-lit night while the traffic speeds up. Good as a game corner for a travel, delivery or city guide site.
how: A demo ride plays on load; press Space, tap the road or press Ride to take the wheel.
Space, Up or W jumps (hold for a higher jump); Down or S ducks under banners, or drops you fast mid-air.
On touch screens use the Jump and Duck pads, tap to jump and swipe down to duck.
Collect coins for 10 points each and grab a chai cup for five seconds of speed with no crashes.
You have three lives; each district adds faster traffic, new obstacles and a bonus.
P pauses, R restarts; your best score and top five runs are kept on this device.
